# Vocabulary: narrative_mode

Where story comes from.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `none` | None | No narrative layer. |
| `authored` | Authored | Writers script story beats and dialogue. |
| `emergent` | Emergent | Story is the player's interpretation of simulation events. |
| `hybrid` | Hybrid | Authored events or templates triggered and recombined by simulation state. |
| `generative` | Generative | A learned model produces narrative text, dialogue, or events at runtime. |
